label: B25-BOARD-USER-ATTESTED-FLASH-BOOT-PREFLIGHT
title: Allow an explicit user-attested Flash boot baseline without treating cached JTAG design hash as live identity
reads: T-053 read-only preflight evidence and user confirmation of Flash-booted VexRiscv/Linux
T-040 tracked B25 board runner/SOP and negative matrix
scope: Add an explicit fail-closed initial-chain policy. Default contracts continue requiring the frozen golden design hash. Only T-053 with its exact frozen candidate/golden identities and the fixed user-attested Flash-boot token may treat standard jtagconfig design hash as diagnostic while retaining cable/JTAG-ID/UART/PHY, EDA, port, SOF identity, candidate transaction, and final golden transaction checks.
acceptance: Local board-runner matrix proves default golden-hash gate is unchanged; T-053's fixed user-attested policy validates only for exact task/candidate/golden identities and rejects missing/wrong attestation, other task IDs, changed SOF hashes, malformed paths, persistent formats, or other safety relaxation. Preflight logs the observed design hash and policy without claiming it is live identity. `make b25-board-runner-check` passes; no remote/Quartus/JTAG/terminal action occurs.
forbidden_regions: Quartus programmer, JTAG programming, nios2-terminal, Flash/EPCQ, reset or power
changing candidate or golden SOF identities
disabling cable/JTAG-ID/UART/PHY or process/port safety checks
removing T-053 final golden restore requirement
accepting user-attested mode for tasks other than exact T-053 payload
resource: Local L0 contract tests only; no GamePC or hardware use.
